name: A2UI
summary: A2UI is an open protocol, created by Google, for agents to describe interactive interfaces as declarative JSON instead of code. The client renders those descriptions with its own native widgets and only allows components from a pre-approved catalog, so the same agent output can appear on web, mobile and desktop.
facts: Google, with CopilotKit and community contributors
goodFor: Agents that must render natively on several platforms
Showing UI from untrusted remote agents without running their code
watchOut: Limited to components in the client's catalog
